name: Markdown Preview
description: VSCode-style rendered Markdown preview in a side panel: real GFM tables, task lists, quotes, syntax-highlighted code blocks, collapsible headings and click-to-source jumps.
author: yyn0210

commands.label: Markdown: Preview
commands.description: Open or refresh the rendered Markdown preview

commands.label: Markdown: Toggle Heading Fold
commands.description: Collapse or expand the section under a heading (from the preview panel)

commands.label: Markdown: Go to Source Line
commands.description: Move the editor cursor to a preview paragraph's source line

settings.label: Show link targets
settings.description: Append the destination URL after link text (off by default, like VSCode/IDEA previews).

settings.label: Show front matter
settings.description: Render YAML front matter instead of hiding it.

zh-CN.name: Markdown 预览
zh-CN.description: 侧栏中的 VSCode 风格 Markdown 渲染预览：真实 GFM 表格、任务列表、引用、语法高亮代码块、可折叠标题和点击跳转源行。

markdown.preview.label: Markdown：预览
markdown.preview.description: 打开或刷新 Markdown 渲染预览

markdown.toggle-heading.label: Markdown：折叠/展开标题
markdown.toggle-heading.description: 折叠或展开标题下的章节（在预览面板中操作）

markdown.goto-source.label: Markdown：跳到源行
markdown.goto-source.description: 把编辑光标移到预览段落对应的源文件行

show_link_targets.label: 显示链接目标
show_link_targets.description: 在链接文字后附加目标 URL（默认关闭，与 VSCode/IDEA 预览一致）。

show_frontmatter.label: 显示 front matter
show_frontmatter.description: 渲染 YAML front matter，而不是隐藏它。
